parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which you want to migrate the API group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-api-group-instance --group-id 01c97ed08a614118849b00079753d1e2 --target-instance-id apigateway-bj-c325375b1ebe --remark migrate --tag Value=123 Key=env --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyApiGroupInstance --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --Tag.1.Value 123 --TargetInstanceId 'apigateway-bj-c325375b1ebe' --GroupId 01c97ed08a614118849b00079753d1e2 --Remark migrate
